name: Iron Boulder
how: A roaming legendary: it can appear anywhere on the overworld surface, very rarely, at level 70-75. Thunderstorms make it much likelier (Quark Drive / Electric Terrain).
Moves, stats, typing and ability are the official Scarlet/Violet ones (Mighty Cleave at level 56).
Commands: /pokespawn ironboulder or /pokegive ironboulder (add 'shiny' for the shiny).
look: A stone-and-steel paradox with its great blade-horns; it lowers them to charge in battle, rears up to cry and slashes down with Mighty Cleave. Shiny: electric-cyan accents and navy plates.
